title: Reproducibility code: Platform normalization and a null expectation as preconditions for reanalyzing tumor mutational burden in breast cancer (cBioPortal)
description: Python code to reproduce the analyses of the manuscript "Platform Normalization and a Null Expectation as Preconditions for Reanalyzing Tumor Mutational Burden: A Reassessment of 3381 Breast Cancer Samples from Public Genomic Cohorts" (IJERPH, manuscript ijerph-4617917). The code downloads public data from cBioPortal (brca_tcga_pan_can_atlas_2018, breast_msk_2018, brca_mbcproject_2022). No patient-level data are included.
